input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours... conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Matches the preferred position on every parameter: once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor under confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and 22.2 expressly bars direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data and privileged material. Section 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) adds no separate audit burden on us. No redline.

input.quote: Vendor shall continue the Services while a payment dispute is pending and shall not charge interest on an amount ultimately found not due.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty or minimum termination fee is payable by Customer. Section 9.4 gives convenience termination with no early-termination fee, 7.3 protects disputed amounts from interest, and 27.3 allows termination "without penalty". The Section 2.1 take-or-pay is the nearest analogue but is a purchase commitment rather than a liquidated-damages clause and is handled under MINCOMMIT. No redline for this rule.

input.quote: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
input.rationale: Fifteen days is below even our fallback (90 days for software / 30 for services), and the "after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation" cut-off would neutralise the general conformance warranty in 19.1 and the re-perform/repair/refund remedy in 19.4. Extended to 90 days and expressly preserved the 19.1/19.3 warranties and other remedies; the rest of Section 19 (professional-workmanlike standard, no malicious code, compliance with law, and a disclaimer in 19.5 that does not swallow express warranties) is acceptable.

input.quote: commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18.1 meets every preferred limit (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber/privacy 5M, workers' comp per law) for the term plus one year, and 18.2 adds certificates on request, cancellation notice and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No redline.
